title: Pentagon Tells Congress US Cost of Iran War Has Risen to $47.1 Billion
detail: The Pentagon reportedly told Congress the US military cost of the Iran war has risen to $47.1 billion. Reported via aggregator headline; figure not independently confirmed.

title: WSJ: US Warns Gulf States of Possible Short, Intense Renewal of Iran War After Midterms
detail: The Wall Street Journal reportedly says the US has warned Gulf states of a possible short, intense renewal of the war with Iran after the midterm elections. Reported via aggregator; not independently confirmed.
